suppress.notes: AndroidX SQLite 2.6.2 is not SQLite core 2.6.2. sqlite-framework delegates to the platform-native implementation; sqlite-bundled is the separate artifact that compiles SQLite from source. https://developer.android.com/jetpack/androidx/releases/sqlite
AndroidX Lifecycle ViewModel is unrelated to the four Apache products inferred solely from the shared 2.10.0 version.

CVE-2026-53914 concerns unsafe deserialization of Kotlin build-cache metadata, not these APK runtime jars. CI separately enforces a trusted-main-only writer for cross-run Gradle cache state. https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-53914
